fullPassage: Being alone makes us more creative. Many great artists and thinkers throughout history have lived by themselves. When we are alone, we have fewer distractions. This allows our thoughts to run free without interruption or judgment. Creative people have entire worlds inside their heads, and being alone gives them the opportunity to bring ideas from this inner world into the real world. Steve Wozniak, for example, invented the Apple computer sitting alone at a desk. He says his creativity came from being introverted as a child. Had it not been for his shyness, he might not have become a computer expert. However, this does not mean we should stop working together with others. Had it not been for Wozniak's collaboration with Steve Jobs, he could not have started his own business. Therefore, we should seek out solitude, but only when we need it.

questions.passage: Being alone makes us more creative. Many great artists and thinkers throughout history have lived by themselves. When we are alone, we have (A)[more / fewer] distractions. This allows our thoughts to run free without interruption or judgment. Had it not been for his shyness, he might not have become a computer expert. However, this does not mean we should stop working together with others. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) fewer=더 적은 / more=더 많은 (B) opportunity=기회 / difficulty=어려움 (C) real=실제의 / imaginary=상상의
det.analysis:
① fewer—opportunity—real: 혼자면 방해가 더 적고(fewer), 아이디어를 내볼 기회(opportunity)를 얻어, 내면세계에서 실제(real) 세계로 옮긴다 ←정답
② more—opportunity—imaginary: (A) 혼자면 방해가 '더 많은(more)' 게 아니라 '더 적음' (C) 내면에서 '실제' 세계로
③ fewer—difficulty—real: (B) 아이디어를 낼 '어려움(difficulty)'이 아니라 '기회(opportunity)'를 줌
④ more—difficulty—imaginary: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 혼자 → 방해 더 적음(fewer) → 아이디어 낼 기회(opportunity) → 실제(real) 세계로

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 run의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: run: (A) (생각·시간이) 자유롭게 흐르다/전개되다 (B) 달리다
det.analysis:
① (A) (생각이) 흐르다 (B) 달리다: 생각이 방해 없이 자유롭게 '흐르다', 강가를 따라 '달리다' ←정답
② (A) 달리다 (B) (생각이) 흐르다: (A)(B) 뒤바뀜
③ (A) 운영하다 (B) 달리다: (A) 생각을 '운영'한다는 건 어색
④ (A) (생각이) 흐르다 (B) 운영하다: (B) 강가를 '운영'한다는 건 어색
det.tip: run의 다의어: (생각이) 흐르다 vs 달리다(run along the river)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the state of being alone, especially when you enjoy it"

det.korean: judgment=판단 / interruption=방해 / collaboration=협력 / solitude=고독
det.analysis:
① judgment: 판단 — 혼자 있는 상태와 무관
② interruption: 방해 — 상태가 아니라 행위
③ collaboration: 협력 — 함께 하는 것이라 반대
④ solitude: 혼자 있는 상태(특히 그것을 즐길 때) ←정답
det.tip: the state of being alone(혼자 있는 상태) = 고독(solitude)

questions.passage: Steve Wozniak invented the Apple computer sitting alone at a desk. He says his __________ (creative) came from being introverted as a child.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: creative(형용사) → creativity(명사). 소유격 his 뒤 명사 자리
det.analysis: creative(창의적인)를 명사 creativity(창의성)로 바꿔요. 앞에 소유격 his(그의)가 있고 뒤에 동사 came(왔다)이 있어서, 그 사이는 주어 역할을 하는 명사 자리예요. 그래서 형용사 creative가 아니라 명사 creativity가 맞아요.
det.tip: 소유격(his) + ___ + 동사(came) → 명사 자리. creative → creativity

questions.passage: Many great artists and __________ (think) throughout history have lived by themselves. Being alone made them more creative.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: think(동사) → thinkers(명사, ~하는 사람들). artists와 and로 이어지는 명사 자리, 복수동사 have와 호응
det.analysis: think(생각하다)를 명사 thinkers(사상가들)로 바꿔요. 앞의 artists(예술가들)와 and로 나란히 연결되는 자리라 '사람'을 뜻하는 명사가 와야 해요. '~하는 사람'은 동사 뒤에 -er을 붙이고, 여럿이라 -s까지 붙여 thinkers(생각하는 사람들=사상가들)로 써요. 뒤의 복수동사 have와도 맞아요.
det.tip: artists and ___ (명사 자리) + 복수동사 have → thinkers

questions.passage: Being alone makes us more creative. Many great artists and thinkers throughout history have lived by themselves. When we are alone, we have fewer distractions. This allows our thoughts to run free without interruption or judgment. Creative people have entire worlds inside their heads, and being alone gives them the opportunity to bring ideas from this inner world into the real world. Steve Wozniak, for example, invented the Apple computer sitting alone at a desk. He says his creativity came from being introverted as a child. Had it not been for his shyness, he might not have become a computer expert. However, this does not mean we should stop working together with others. Had it not been for Wozniak's collaboration with Steve Jobs, he could not have started his own business. Therefore, we should seek out solitude, but only __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: to please others=남을 기쁘게 하려고 / when we need it=우리가 필요로 할 때만 / at any cost=어떤 대가를 치르더라도 / without any reason=아무 이유 없이
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 'but only(그러나 오직)'와, 함께 일하는 것도 중요하다는 앞 내용이 단서예요.
① to please others: 남을 기쁘게? 고독을 찾는 이유와 안 맞음
② when we need it: 협력도 중요하니 '필요할 때만' 고독을 찾자 ←정답
③ at any cost: 어떤 대가를 치르더라도? 'only(오직)'와 어울리지 않고 지나침
④ without any reason: 아무 이유 없이? 'only'와 모순
det.tip: 협력도 중요 + 'seek out solitude but only ___' → 필요할 때만(when we need it)

questions.passage: Being alone makes us more creative. Many great artists and thinkers throughout history have lived by themselves. When we are alone, we have fewer distractions. This allows our thoughts to run free without interruption or judgment. Creative people have entire worlds inside their heads, and being alone gives them the opportunity to bring ideas from this inner world __________. Steve Wozniak, for example, invented the Apple computer sitting alone at a desk. He says his creativity came from being introverted as a child. Had it not been for his shyness, he might not have become a computer expert. However, this does not mean we should stop working together with others. Had it not been for Wozniak's collaboration with Steve Jobs, he could not have started his own business. Therefore, we should seek out solitude, but only when we need it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: into the past=과거로 / for a short time=잠시 동안 / into the real world=현실 세계로 / out of their reach=손이 닿지 않는 곳으로
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 'bring ideas from this inner world(내면세계에서 아이디어를 가져와)'가 단서로, inner(내면)와 대비되는 곳이 와야 해요.
① into the past: 과거로? 내면과 대비되는 공간이 아님
② for a short time: 잠시 동안? 'from ~ 에서 ~로'의 '~로'에 안 맞음
③ into the real world: 내면세계(inner world)에서 '현실 세계로' 아이디어를 옮김 ←정답
④ out of their reach: 손이 닿지 않는 곳으로? 아이디어를 실현한다는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: inner world(내면세계)에서 ___ → 대비되는 현실 세계로(into the real world)
